_about: The 2^3 ablation matrix (CD-1).  Selected with `--cell A4`.
Values here are folded into the argument parser's DEFAULTS, so anything
passed explicitly on the command line still overrides them.  Resolution
order, weakest to strongest:  code defaults < this file < command line.
`defaults` applies to every cell.  Three of its entries exist because the
upstream defaults would silently produce a different experiment:
do_seathru        upstream False -> the medium model never activates and
every cell would be a study of plain 3DGS.
seathru_from_iter upstream 9_000_000, i.e. past the end of training --
the same 'defaults disable the method' trap.
eval              upstream False -> empty test set, trains on everything,
reports inflated numbers, raises no error.
Mechanism-specific keys (the primitive budget, codebook size, re-warm-up
length, ...) are added to this file as each mechanism lands, so that the
cell definition and the manifest always describe the same run.
_n_bud_note: n_bud (the M2 primitive budget) is deliberately NOT set here.
It must be derived from A0's converged primitive count, which no
publication of the baseline reports, so it is not knowable until A0 has
run.  Pass it on the command line for every m2 cell:  --n_bud <count>.
Preflight refuses to start an m2 run without it, because a budget that
does not bind makes A4 equivalent to A1 and A7 to A5 -- and a null
interaction measured in that state is a configuration artifact.

_storage_note: The inherited save schedule writes the model at 4 iterations and a
checkpoint at 4 more. At ~1M primitives that is roughly 900 MB per run,
or ~86 GB across 96 runs -- more than a normal Drive holds.
Checkpoints in particular have NO operational value here: interrupted
runs are restarted rather than resumed (CD-18), because the checkpoint
omits the medium model, the codebooks and the loop's schedule flags.
Writing 4 per run to support a resume path that is deliberately unused
Keeping only the final model brings a run to roughly 60-120 MB and the
campaign to ~6-12 GB. Everything the analysis needs -- diagnostics,
eval_metrics, the compressed artifact, run_config -- is unaffected.
_test_iterations_note: Upstream evaluates every 1000 iterations -- 30 full evaluations per run,
each rendering every train and test view and running VGG-LPIPS over
them. That is real wall-clock inside the figure this study reports as
training time. Four checkpoints are enough to see the trajectory, and
the final evaluation is what the results use.
What matters most is that this is identical across cells: an evaluation
schedule that varied between them would put a confound straight into

A0.description: Baseline. SeaSplat unmodified. Reference for every contrast, and the run that supplies the primitive budget the other cells need.

A1.description: M1 only. Dense correspondence initialization; densification disabled, alpha-pruning and opacity reset retained (R-4).

A2.description: M2 only. Importance-weighted stochastic simplification to the primitive budget, with the medium re-identification burst (CD-6). Carries the study's central hypothesis.

A3.description: M3 only. Quantization-aware VQ over three codebooks. Expected to show ~no frame-rate gain, because CompGS-VQ's opacity regulariser is disabled (CD-8).

A4.description: M1+M2. Degeneracy risk: if M1 converges below the budget the prune is a no-op and A4 collapses onto A1. Whether the budget bound is reported per run (G-2).

A5.description: M1+M3. The least-coupled pair: no shared pipeline stage, and quantization touches neither position nor opacity. Predicted additive.

A6.description: M2+M3. The one interaction with external theory behind it: a sparser primitive set is predicted to be more sensitive to lossy attribute compression. Informative in both directions.

A7.description: Fully stacked. Source of the effect-from-above contrasts; inherits every integration decision and both degeneracy risks.
